item.title: How to define mutations in Vuex
item.description: Vuex mutations are the only way to change store state in Vue applications, providing predictable state updates with proper debugging and time-travel capabilities. As the creator of CoreUI, I use mutations extensively for reliable state management across enterprise applications. The most effective approach is defining mutations as synchronous functions that receive state and payload parameters for direct state modification. This ensures traceable, debuggable state changes that work seamlessly with Vue DevTools and maintain application predictability.
